commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Substitution. Giuliano Simeone is replaced by Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Las Palmas couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jesus Owono (Alaves) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
88' Francisco Maeso blows his whistle and signals a foul after Carlos Vicente (Alaves) brought his opponent down. That's a free kick to Las Palmas.
85' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

74' The referee is firm and issues Fabio Gonzalez (Las Palmas) a deserved yellow card.

67' Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
65' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Alex Suarez is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).

60' The free kick from long range, taken by Alaves, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
58' Substitution. Munir El Haddadi walks off the pitch and Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
58' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Alvaro Lemos and he is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
58' Rafa Marin (Alaves) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the left post.

55' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.

46' The whistle blows and Francisco Maeso starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
44' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
43' The ball is cleared after Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
42' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) picks up a long through ball, but Jesus Owono deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

41' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
38' Jesus Owono is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Alvaro Lemos (Las Palmas). Easy save!
37' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
36' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Valles intercepts the ball.
35' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
35' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.

33' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the bottom left corner, but Alvaro Valles keeps his cool to thwart him.
33' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) is going to take the penalty!
32' A player from Las Palmas pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Alaves are given a penalty!
32' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
32' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
31' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

27' A great solo effort from Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot towards the left post. Jesus Owono has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
26' Ander Guevara (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
24' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

14' Good work from Alaves as they win a corner.
13' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. Alaves win a corner.
11' Giuliano Simeone (Alaves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
9' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
5' The Las Palmas players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
1' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
